snapshot: WHO African Region. Reworking its health system under Vision Sénégal 2050, with a push for pharmaceutical sovereignty and domestic vaccine financing as Gavi support tapers off.

leadership.role: Minister of Health and Public Hygiene
leadership.name: Ibrahima Sy

agenda.title: Health budget 2027 and vaccine financing
agenda.text: Presenting the 2027 health budget to the National Assembly on 9 November 2026, Minister Ibrahima Sy stressed securing vaccine financing as external partners, notably Gavi, gradually withdraw. The budget is built around governance and full digitalisation of the sector under Vision Sénégal 2050.

agenda.title: US health MoU and pharmaceutical sovereignty
agenda.text: Senegal and the United States signed a five-year health MoU on 13 March 2026 under the America First strategy: about US$135 million, with US$63 million from the US and US$72 million from Senegal, covering HIV, malaria, surveillance and epidemic preparedness. The State Department says it includes a goal of producing 30% of medicines locally with Senegalese funds.

agenda.title: A new government, same health minister
agenda.text: President Faye ended Ousmane Sonko's term as prime minister in May 2026 and named Ahmadou Al Aminou Lo; the new government of 1 June 2026 formed without Sonko's Pastef. Ibrahima Sy kept the health portfolio. The president has asked for a new Health Code and close follow-up of pharmaceutical sovereignty projects.
